subject.title: feat: clarify publisher discovery state labels

question: Should this PR establish the durable publisher profile/discovery trust-label vocabulary now, or should it wait for consolidation with the adjacent account-feed work?
rationale: The code change is narrow and aligned with existing official-publisher state, but the new spec turns the vocabulary into future product intent while related feed/discovery drafts are still open.

options.title: Accept Narrow Vocabulary After Proof
options.body: Require real browser proof, then land this focused Official/status-label slice as the current profile/discovery vocabulary.

options.title: Consolidate With Feed Stack First
options.body: Keep the PR open until the account-feed and discovery drafts settle the vocabulary together.

options.title: Accept As Draft Direction Only
options.body: Keep or split the spec direction while deferring visible UI labels until more backing feed/review/follow state exists.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Vocabulary After Proof
recommendation.body: Require real browser proof, then land this focused Official/status-label slice as the current profile/discovery vocabulary.

likelyOwner.reason: The current official-publisher UI and policy spec are tied to this person's recent mainline work, making them the best available routing owner for vocabulary acceptance.
